# Non-text cell editors are unwitnessed on nested fields, in tree columns and across projection loss

## Context

Named at the closeout of #18762. The grid cell-editing arms drive non-text editors (Number, Date, Combo) only on the public example's flat fields, at a width where every column fits. Nested record fields and tree columns are witnessed with text editors only (#18981, PR #18983). Row and column projection loss is also witnessed with text editors only (#18764, #18843, #18885). @neo-fable released this as a claimable lane (A2A, 2026-09-19 16:02Z): text editors on nested and tree shapes are measured healthy, and non-text ones are unmeasured.

## The Problem

The plugin's session and projection never read the editor type, so the nesting and pooling contracts should carry over to every editor. Two things fall outside that argument:
- **Each field's own value round-trip through a nested path:** a Date, a number, or a ComboBox record value written into `user.<field>` or a tree column.
- **A picker editor whose field loses its projection while the picker is open.** The picker floats outside the row, and its field unmounts under it. The epic's contract is that scrolling neither commits nor cancels, and that returning reprojects the same editor.

## The Fix

Test-first. Put arms on `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-cell-editing-record-shapes` for the nested and tree cases. Put arms on a pooled grid carrying a picker editor for horizontal and vertical projection loss with the picker open. Fix whatever falls out at the owning layer: the field, not the grid, per #18762's review (Stage 4).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Number, Date and Combo editors commit into a nested field and into a tree column. Each arm is killed by a named mutation.
- [ ] A picker editor whose picker is open keeps its editor instance and draft across projection loss and return, and the picker does not float over a vanished field. Otherwise the defect found is fixed at its owning layer, in its own ticket if it is not one PR's work.

## Out of Scope

New editor types · Table editing · an example rewrite.

## Related

#18762 (the closed epic) · #18981 / PR #18983 (the record-shapes fixture) · #18838, #18925 (picker editors on flat fields).
